events.description: Setup of the four complex planes (A, B, C, D) in a 2x2 grid layout with coordinate axes.
events.clip_query: Four coordinate planes arranged in a two-by-two grid

events.description: Displaying the initial Droste-effect image on Plane A.
events.clip_query: A Droste-effect image displayed on the top-left complex plane

events.description: Mapping the Droste image to the log-plane (Plane B) using the complex logarithm function.
events.clip_query: The image unwrapped into parallel strips on the top-right complex plane

events.description: Applying a shear/rotation transformation in the log-plane (Plane C) using a complex multiplier.
events.clip_query: The unwrapped strips rotated and sheared on the bottom-left complex plane

events.description: Mapping the transformed log-plane back to the exponential plane (Plane D) to form the seamless spiral.
events.clip_query: The sheared strips mapped back into a seamless tilted spiral on the bottom-right complex plane
